kicker: NONE OF THEM HAPPEN IN THE GYM
title: 8 ways to be *disgustingly manly*

items.head: Answer to something above you
items.sub: A man with nothing above him makes himself the ceiling.

items.head: Same voice for everyone
items.sub: The cleaner at 9PM gets the respect the owner gets.

items.head: Give away what you could sell
items.sub: Last winter's jacket, the spare tools. Hand them over.

items.head: Be terrible at something
items.sub: Get tapped by a guy 60 lbs lighter. Ego blocks every skill.

head: 5. Carry more than your share
l: Waits to be asked for help

head: Be the one who drives
sub: Someone's tired, nobody knows the route. Get everyone home.

head: 7. Stand between the problem and the person
l: "Let me know if you need anything"

head: Keep your word when it gets expensive
sub: Said you'd be at the game, then the client called. Go anyway.

pre: None of these show up in a mirror:
text: They show up in *how people feel when you walk in.*

head: Do *one* of these this week
sub: Nobody needs to know you did it.
